description.p: This is a community package of Audionaut, maintained independently and unaffiliated with its developer. It repackages the official upstream Linux release unmodified and follows upstream releases automatically.

Audionaut is a free, open-source desktop application for audio editing and recording. Whether you are working on music, podcasts or multitrack recordings, it gives you precise cutting, per-track playlists, multi-channel support and clean exports, without the weight of a full DAW.

ul.li: Multitrack, multichannel, region-based and non-destructive editing
Clip gain, bendable fades and crossfades, clip speed with pitch-preserving time-stretch
Audio analysis and Auto Edit: segment boundaries, onsets and beat tracking
Stem separation into drums, bass, other and vocals, running locally
Recording with takes, loop playback, snap to grid, tempo sync via Ableton Link
Export to WAV, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis and MP3

description.p: Stem separation downloads the Demucs model weights (about 80 MB) on first use; all processing then happens on your machine. Anonymous usage statistics are opt-in and asked about on first launch.

Permissions: this package grants the display, the GPU, the sound server (playback and recording), network access (the model download, the update notice, Ableton Link and the opt-in statistics) and your home folder, because projects are folders that the app's own file browser opens directly. With that grant the app uses the same places as a native install: settings in ~/.config/voltmer-systems and new projects in ~/Music/Audionaut. The update notice only tells you a new version exists; updates arrive through this Flatpak remote.
